notes: There was no git history, so I treated the step-2 reconcile/watch tests in test_sync.py as the checked set. Most names describe what their bodies assert (e.g. test_type_change_is_a_change, test_watch_survives_broken_edit). Two overclaim: test_reconcile_failure_shows_error checks only exit code 4 and history length, never any error output, and test_commands_reconcile_hand_edits shows only `show` reconciling while asserting that `history` does not. Two more are vague: test_set_in_subprocess_while_watching names no expected result, and test_special_values_round_trip only counts events.
